perks.name: Iron Sharpens Iron
perks.description: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
perks.exact:
On Elite+/Guardian Kill:
+12% Special and +7.5% Heavy Ammo Progress.

perks.name: Ascendant Escape
perks.description: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Kill:
Grants Ascendant Escape.

Ascendant Escape: Upon reaching Critical Health or being damaged while at Critical Health:
Invisibility for 6+? seconds.

archetype.name: Skirmisher
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians that thrive in chaos.

Primary Stat: Melee
Secondary Stat: Weapons

item.name: Balanced Tuning
item.description: Slightly increases the three lowest stats on this armor at no cost.

item.name: Void Scavenger
item.description: Void weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.

item.name: Weapons Font
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
While Armor Charge is active:

+20 | +40 | +50 Weapons.

item.name: Recuperation
item.description: Replenishes health each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:

Restores 16 | 21 | 21 Health.
